analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 25,670) vs SMA5 (KRW 28,047) / SMA20 (KRW 28,047) / SMA50 (KRW 32,535): Below SMA5, below SMA20/SMA50 indicates weak short-to-medium term trend.
· Position vs SMA100 (KRW 34,774) / SMA200 (KRW 36,515): Below long-term averages, indicating weakness.
· 52-week position (22.3%) + Current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (42.8→39.3): Neutral range sustained, failing to exit oversold territory.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-37.5263→-33.6509): Improving within negative territory, weak signal for trend reversal.

· Swing Resistance (KRW 30,570): Below Pivot R1 (KRW 31,657), breakthrough could signal trend change.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern: Neither Higher Low nor Lower High pattern met; sideways consolidation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.53x): Below 5-day average volume, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis: Accumulation phase, maintaining a wait-and-see stance due to lack of clear direction.
